items.q: Why must Optiver decide on AI fast?
items.a: **P&L impact shows within hours**, so missed opportunities are **costly**.

items.q: Where does Optiver run its AI?
items.a: **On-prem**, with third-party inference only under **zero data retention**.

items.q: What is forward deployment at Optiver?
items.a: AI engineers **sit with traders** to learn workflows and **bring lessons back** to the platform.

items.q: What does same-day model adoption require?
items.a: **Internal golden benchmarks**, an **inference gateway** and harness updates ready to go.

items.q: Why does Optiver use internal benchmarks?
items.a: External benchmarks' **data distribution** doesn't match its **own use cases**.

items.q: What does the inference gateway provide?
items.a: **Routing**, **per-model budgets** and **failover** when a provider goes down.

items.q: What waste did Optiver find in fresh sessions?
items.a: **200k+ tokens** of default context from **dumped MCPs** and knowledge.

items.q: How did Optiver cut context spend?
items.a: **MCP tool search**, **CLIs wrapping MCPs** and **cache tuning**.

items.q: Why scope agents narrowly instead of growing one big agent?
items.a: Small agents are **easy to measure** and manage; bloated ones get **better and worse** at once.
